nodes.name: Every day 18:30
nodes.notes: Daily at 18:30 (n8n workspace timezone -> set it to Europe/Lisbon in Settings). Opens confirmations for TOMORROW's booked slots. Safe to run more than once a day: confirmations_start skips slots that already have an active confirmation conversation.

nodes.name: confirmations_start
nodes.notes: Fat RPC: opens one 'confirmation' conversation per still-booked slot tomorrow and returns a row per slot: { conversation_id, slot_id, patient{name}, slot{start_time,doctor_name} }. Empty [] on a day with nothing to confirm -> the run just ends.

nodes.name: Fan out slots
nodes.notes: One item per slot to confirm. If confirmations_start returned [], this emits nothing and the workflow ends cleanly.

nodes.name: agent_context
nodes.notes: Runs once per slot. Gives clinic_name + patient for the persona. The conversation has no messages yet — this is agent-initiated.

nodes.name: Build confirm prompt
nodes.notes: Formats tomorrow's time in Europe/Lisbon and assembles the system + user prompts. No medical data — only name + time.

nodes.name: agent_send_message
nodes.notes: Posts the confirmation with the service_role key -> lands in the /sms thread and staff /conversations console. When the patient replies SIM/NÃO, the inbound trigger fires WF-A, which routes it to confirmation_confirm / confirmation_decline.

nodes.name: Trigger phase 2
nodes.notes: Kicks off WF-D (pull-forward) once per confirmation run. WF-D waits PHASE2_DELAY_SECONDS then offers earlier slots.
